title: Italian trumpet players in Los Angeles
summary: Candoli says the many Italian trumpeters, such as Conrad Gozzo, were an accident, and mentions the non-Italian Don Fagerquist.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Gozzo. And a lot of Italian trumpet players. What is that?

Well quite by accident I guess. I know Conrad Gozzo and then there are the other trumpet players, trumpet players like Don Fagerquist, which was a great studio trumpet player, great jazz trumpet player, but really never got the chance to record that much. But he’s on all of Sinatra’s records, he’s on all of the commercial records. He was a good trumpet player, and not Italian.
There were a few that weren’t Italian. Well man, you got with Woody Herman when you were still in your teens?
